title: No Surprises Act Good Faith Estimate Issuance at Riverbend (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
**1. Coverage inquiry and notice.** At scheduling, and whenever a patient asks about cost, the scheduler asks whether the patient has coverage and whether they intend to have it billed (required on every Good Faith & Price Estimates type), and gives the notice of the right to a good faith estimate on the estimate types where that notice is required.

**2. Who receives a good faith estimate.** A patient who is uninsured, or who is insured but asks not to have the claim submitted (self-pay elected), receives a good faith estimate on the estimate types where a good faith estimate is required.

**3. When it is furnished.** A good faith estimate is furnished:
- within the type's furnishing period for services scheduled at least 10 business days ahead, counted in business days after the scheduling date, when the service is scheduled at least 10 business days ahead;
- within the type's furnishing period for services scheduled at least the minimum scheduling lead but fewer than 10 business days ahead, counted after the scheduling date, when it is so scheduled;
- within the type's furnishing period for unscheduled requests, counted in business days after an unscheduled request.

Business days follow the business-day calendar of the estimate type. A service scheduled fewer business days ahead than the minimum scheduling lead does not require one, but one is still furnished on request.

**4. Insured patients.** An insured patient who has the claim submitted receives the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate within the insured turnaround period in business days, and only after benefits are verified on the types where benefit verification is required.

**5. Delivery and retention.** The estimate is delivered on paper or electronically as the patient chooses, through the delivery channels of its type, and is retained for the record-retention period of its type in years.

## Decision table

| Request | Good faith estimate due? | Period counted from |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduled 10 or more business days ahead | yes | the scheduling date |
| Scheduled at least the minimum lead, fewer than 10 business days ahead | yes | the scheduling date |
| Scheduled fewer business days ahead than the minimum lead | not required; furnished on request | — |
| Unscheduled request | yes | the request |
| Insured, claim to be submitted | the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate instead, after benefit verification | the request |

Boundary (hypothetical): a service scheduled exactly 10 business days ahead is "at least 10 business days ahead" and falls in the first row; one scheduled 9 business days ahead falls in the second row.
